```
['dispatch an AWS Polly text-to-speech request with voice, format, and speed parameters', 'map OpenAI TTS parameters to AWS Polly SynthesizeSpeech API parameters', 'transform an OpenAI TTS request into a signed AWS Polly SynthesizeSpeech request', 'transform an AWS Polly audio response into a standard HttpxBinaryResponseContent', 'validate AWS environment credentials and set up request headers for Polly API calls']

```
